 _,success,done=s.step(a);actions.append(np.array(a).copy())
 if done and not success:raise RuntimeError('budget')

def pos(name):return s.data.xpos[model.body(name).id].copy()

def ik(target,rot=R):
 ikdata.qpos[:]=s.data.qpos
 for _ in range(120):
  mujoco.mj_forward(model,ikdata)
  e=np.r_[np.array(target)-ikdata.site_xpos[site], Rotation.from_matrix(rot@ikdata.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
